messages:
OpsBot: INCIDENT 🚨 — spike in 5xx errors for smart-routing fallback policy. Alerting SRE oncall. error_rate_rolling_5m: 18% (threshold 2%).
PagerDuty: Pager duty triggered for sanjay — escalation path: sanjay -> aya -> mike.
Sanjay (oncall): acked. I'm pulling the console and logs now. seeing a lot of `ModelVariantMismatch` in the routing service, and a flurry of cross-region reroutes from eu-west->us-west.
Aya: can you paste the failing request logs? is this new config pushed in last hour?
Sanjay (oncall): pasted minimal log sample:
```
2026-03-15T14:32:11Z route_id=smart-route-42 request_id=abc123 region=eu-west target_variant=redwood-7b-q4_0 error=ModelVariantMismatch
2026-03-15T14:32:11Z routing_action=fallback region=us-west selected_variant=redwood-7b-int8
2026-03-15T14:32:11Z client_retry header=x-retries=2
```
Aya: ugh. looks like the fallback map had `redwood-7b-q4_0 -> redwood-7b-int8` but `int8` variant isn't compatible for streaming endpoints. That will return 5xx and trigger client retries.
Mike: also seeing a routing loop: when us-west gets the traffic it hits its capacity and triggers its own fallback to another zone, and because clients retry on 5xx with no jitter the same requests come back and double the traffic. basically a retry amplification / thundering herd.
Katie: do we have a quick mitigation? disable the fallback policy? set it to fail-open=false?
Sanjay (oncall): I'm going to temporarily pin smart-route-42 to `redwood-7b-q4_0` (no fallback) and set a conservative per-route rate limit at the edge. executing console command now:
```
# disable fallback
redwoodctl routes update smart-route-42 --fallback-policy=off
# apply per-route rate limit
redwoodctl routes update smart-route-42 --rate-limit=600rps
```
OpsBot: config change accepted. Route smart-route-42 updated — fallback-policy=off, rate-limit=600rps.
PagerDuty: note: change triggered a deploy job id=deploy-8792.
Aya: after disabling fallback, error rate dropped from 18% -> 3% in 90s. good. but we still need to mitigate retry storms from clients. recommend: return `429 Retry-After` for overloaded tokens at the edge for 30s, and add `Retry-After` header so clients back off.
Mike: rolling that now — edge will surface 429 for the route when queue depth > T. Also adding `x-backoff-suggested: exponential` header for SDKs.
Sanjay (oncall): SDKs updated to respect `x-backoff-suggested`? We might need to contact major customers.
Katie: quick patch to router to drop cross-region fallback for this route to avoid looping. set `allow-region-fallback=false` on smart-route-42.
Sanjay (oncall): applied. logs show fewer cross-region handoffs.
Aya: we should also fix the underlying cause: the fallback mapping is wrong (variant alias mispointing). Who pushed the change? Change was in infra-config repo 14:22UTC by mike.platform.
Mike: that was me — I was testing an alias update earlier but didn't include a variant compatibility matrix. My bad. I'll revert the alias and add compatibility checks.
Sanjay (oncall): timeline so far: 14:32 alert -> 14:34 disabled fallback and rate-limited -> 14:36 applied 429/backoff headers -> 14:38 disabled cross-region fallback -> errors trending down.
Aya: customer impact estimate — telemetry shows ~52 customers had degraded tail-latency > 2s, and 13 customers saw 5xx failures for up to 4 minutes. Major affected customers: acme-inc, finvox, chatly (we should reach out to SEs).
Mike: making a fast PR to add automated variant compatibility checks to routing policy push pipeline. also adding a canary gate that tests fallback target responds to basic Liveness + Streaming handshake.
Katie: suggestion: add server-side retry-suppression token when fallback triggers: set `x-retry-suppress=1` on responses coming from fallback so upstream proxies/clients can avoid immediate retries.
Sanjay (oncall): good idea — will file a follow-up. For now, we need to confirm stable. monitoring: error_rate_5m at 0.9%, latency p99 back to normal.
OpsBot: Incident annotated: mitigation actions recorded: disable-fallback, per-route-rate-limit, 429-edge, disable-region-fallback, alias-revert.
Aya: handing off to Aya for next shift — I'll stay online for 15m if anything pops. Sanjay, please confirm you have the oncall rotation note and handover.
Sanjay (oncall): handing off to Aya. I'm out at 15:00 UTC. summary for handoff: cause = faulty fallback alias pointing to incompatible variant + global retry amplification due to aggressive client retries + region fallback loop. mitigations in place: fallback off, rate-limit, 429-backoff, region-fallback blocked, alias reverted. follow-ups: add compatibility check in CI, add server-side retry-suppress header, add exponential backoff suggestion in SDKs, postmortem.
Aya: ack. I'll create a postmortem ticket and start the customer impact outreach doc. assigning owners: Mike -> CI check + alias validation, Katie -> retry-suppress implementation, Sanjay -> postmortem writeup + timeline, Aya -> customer comms + followups.
Sanjay (oncall): leaving note: if any residual spike, escalate to platform lead and consider temporary global capacity increase for us-west.
Mike: PR created: infra-config#412 — adds compatibility matrix and a preflight test that rejects fallback assignments if test fails.
Aya: closing incident: monitoring shows stable for 20m, error rates normal. moving to post-incident review.
OpsBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED by sanjay at 14:51 UTC — severity reduced to Sev3 and will be reviewed.
PagerDuty: escalation cleared.
Sanjay (oncall): thanks all. postmortem draft incoming in the next 48h.
Aya: noted, I'll pick this up during next oncall. :memo:
